text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has received a concern from area residents about illegal parking on the west side of Roxton Road, south of Bloor Street West. The parking activity may negatively impact sightlines, traffic flow, and pedestrian safety. Transportation Services recommends parking enhancements that will deter any parking activity taking place at this location and will improve safety for all road users.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Roxton Road, between Bloor Street West and a point 15 metres south.
